hook.text: Draw Fibonacci levels on a pullback and watch price bounce at 61.8%. Traders swear by it. But why does it work?

buildup.text: Fibonacci ratios—23.6%, 38.2%, 50%, 61.8%—are drawn between a swing high and low to find potential support.

discovery.text: The 61.8% level (the 'golden ratio') is the most-watched. Deep pullbacks often stall there.

twist.text: Fibonacci levels have no mathematical reason to work in markets. They work because enough traders use them.

climax.text: Like moving averages, Fibonacci is self-fulfilling. Belief creates the reality it claims to observe.

punchline.text: The golden ratio works because traders believe it does.

quiz.question: Why do Fibonacci levels seem to work in trading?
options: Self-fulfilling prophecy—many traders use the same levels
